$comment: Translates the capability roles declared in canonical .github/agents/*.agent.md `tools:` lines into each harness's grant. Roles are authoritative; this file only translates them. Rendered by tools/scripts/sync-subagents.mjs via tools/scripts/lib/agent-tool-grants.mjs. See ADR 0081 and issue #421.

roles.search: Glob, grep, and list the tree
roles.web: Fetch and search the public web

cursor.$comment: Cursor subagents have no per-agent tool list; tools are inherited from the parent. The only capability key is `readonly`, which blocks file edits and state-changing shell commands. An agent is readonly unless it declares any of `writableRoles`.
